title: MallWorld Hotel
content: Last night I returned to one of my old standby liminal spaces—an old grand city hotel fallen into disrepair. The overgrown courtyard contained a menagerie of fictitious Australian creatures who frolicked under a sky of pearl. But everyone had an air of disappointment and was always overdressed. I was married to Jason Bateman who could barely hide his disdain for me after I wrote and published a children’s book called The Vegetarian Beast.
